<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
$nullableFalse = new class {
    public function __get(mixed $incoming): ?false {
        if ($incoming === "bad") {
            echo "ENTER;";
            $incoming = true;
            return 0;
        }
        if ($incoming === "nil") { return null; }
        return false;
    }
};
$nullableTrue = new class {
    public function __get(?string $incoming): null|true {
        if ($incoming === "bad") { echo "TRUE_ENTER;"; return false; }
        if ($incoming === "nil") { return null; }
        return true;
    }
};
$unionFalse = new class {
    public function __get(int|string $incoming): false|null {
        if ($incoming === "nil") { return null; }
        return false;
    }
};
$selector = "nil";
echo $nullableFalse->$selector === null ? "FALSE_NULL;" : "BAD_FALSE_NULL;";
echo $nullableFalse->value === false ? "FALSE;" : "BAD_FALSE;";
echo $nullableTrue->nil === null ? "TRUE_NULL;" : "BAD_TRUE_NULL;";
echo $nullableTrue->value === true ? "TRUE;" : "BAD_TRUE;";
echo $unionFalse->nil === null ? "UNION_NULL;" : "BAD_UNION_NULL;";
echo $unionFalse->value === false ? "UNION_FALSE;" : "BAD_UNION_FALSE;";
$nullableFalse->nil;
echo "DROP;";
$destination = 42;
try {
    $destination = $nullableFalse->bad === false;
} catch (TypeError $failure) {
    echo $failure->getMessage();
    echo ";";
}
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_STORE;";
$destination = 24;
try {
    $destination = $nullableTrue->bad === true;
} catch (TypeError $failure) {
    echo $failure->getMessage();
    echo ";";
}
echo $destination === 24 ? "KEEP_TRUE;" : "BAD_TRUE_STORE;";
echo $selector === "nil" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_SELECTOR;";
echo "DONE;";
